goal: Student uses third conditional naturally to express alternative pasts, missed opportunities, and counterfactual scenarios.

units.title: If I had known
units.grammar_focus: Third conditional structure (If + past perfect, would have + past participle)
units.real_life_context: You imagine alternative pasts — what would have happened differently if you'd had different information.

grammar.sentence: If I _____ known, I would have helped.
grammar.explanation: Third conditional: "If + past perfect (had + past participle), would have + past participle". A cláusula com "if" usa past perfect, mesmo no terceiro condicional. Aqui: "If I had known".

grammar.sentence: She _____ called you if she had had time.
grammar.explanation: Cláusula principal: "would have + past participle". "She would have called" — não "would call" (que seria second conditional, presente).

grammar.sentence: If we _____ left earlier, we wouldn't have missed the train.
grammar.explanation: "If + past perfect" — "had left". O contraste com "wouldn't have missed" mostra o terceiro condicional.

grammar.sentence: I _____ told you if I had known.
grammar.explanation: Cláusula principal sempre "would have + past participle". "I would have told you".

grammar.sentence: If she _____ studied, she would have passed.
grammar.explanation: "If she had studied" — past perfect na cláusula if. Aprovaria, mas não estudou.

grammar.sentence: He _____ have come if you had invited him.
grammar.explanation: "He would have come" — would + have + come. Estrutura completa da principal.

grammar.sentence: If they _____ asked, I _____ have helped.
grammar.explanation: "If they had asked, I would have helped" — past perfect + would have past participle.

grammar.sentence: If I would have known, I would have helped.
grammar.hint: "Would" não vai na cláusula "if" — só past perfect
grammar.answer: If I had known, I would have helped.
grammar.explanation: Erro muito comum: usar "would have" na cláusula if. Em third conditional, "if" sempre leva past perfect ("had known"), nunca "would have".

grammar.sentence: She would called you if she had had time.
grammar.answer: She would have called you if she had had time.
grammar.explanation: Principal precisa de "would HAVE + past participle". "Would called" não existe — sempre "would have called".

grammar.passage: If I had known about the meeting, I would have come prepared. She would have called you back if she had had your number. We wouldn't have missed the train if we had left ten minutes earlier.
grammar.question: What would the speaker have done if they had known?
grammar.explanation: The text says "If I had known... I would have come prepared".

listening_speaking.text: If I had known, I would have helped.
She would have called if she had had time.
We wouldn't have missed the train if we had left earlier.
He would have come if you had invited him.
If they had asked, I would have said yes.

units.title: I wish I had
units.grammar_focus: Wishes about the past (I wish + past perfect) — regret
units.real_life_context: You express deep regret about past actions or non-actions.

grammar.sentence: I wish I _____ studied harder.
grammar.explanation: "I wish + past perfect" para arrependimentos sobre o passado. "I wish I had studied" — passou e me arrependo.

grammar.sentence: She wishes she _____ told him the truth.
grammar.explanation: Wish + past perfect para arrependimento passado. "She wishes she had told" — não disse e se arrepende.

grammar.sentence: I wish I _____ taken that opportunity.
grammar.explanation: "I wish I had taken" — past perfect para arrependimento de não ter aproveitado.

grammar.sentence: He wishes he _____ called you back.
grammar.explanation: "He wishes he had called" — past perfect indicando ação passada não realizada.

grammar.sentence: I wish I _____ listened to my parents.
grammar.explanation: "Wish + past perfect" para regret. "I wish I had listened" — não escutei, me arrependo.

grammar.sentence: We wish we _____ left earlier.
grammar.explanation: "We wish we had left earlier" — arrependimento sobre quando saímos.

grammar.sentence: If only I _____ known.
grammar.explanation: "If only" = formação enfática de wish. "If only I had known" — arrependimento dramático.

grammar.sentence: I wish I would have studied harder.
grammar.hint: Use past perfect "had studied", não "would have"
grammar.answer: I wish I had studied harder.
grammar.explanation: Erro comum: "wish + would have". Para passado, use "wish + past perfect" ("had studied"). "Would have" não cabe.

grammar.sentence: She wishes she has told him.
grammar.answer: She wishes she had told him.
grammar.explanation: "Has told" (present perfect) não funciona em wish. Para passado, sempre past perfect "had told".

grammar.passage: I wish I had studied harder in college. She wishes she had taken that job offer. If only we had left earlier — we wouldn't have missed the flight.
grammar.question: What does she wish she had done?
grammar.answer: taken that job offer (or "taken the job")
grammar.explanation: The text says "She wishes she had taken that job offer".

listening_speaking.text: I wish I had studied harder.
She wishes she had taken the offer.
If only we had left earlier.
He wishes he had called you back.
I wish I had listened to my parents.

units.title: What would you have done?
units.grammar_focus: Questions in third conditional (Would you have + past participle + if?)
units.real_life_context: You ask hypothetical past questions to explore decisions and alternative outcomes.

grammar.sentence: What _____ you have done if you had known?
grammar.explanation: Pergunta em third conditional: "WH + would have + past participle + if + past perfect?". "What would you have done?" — pergunta hipotética sobre o passado.

grammar.sentence: _____ you have helped if I had asked?
grammar.explanation: "Would + subject + have + past participle + if + past perfect?". "Would you have helped?" — yes/no question third conditional.

grammar.sentence: Where _____ you have gone if you _____ had the money?
grammar.explanation: "Would you have gone... if you had had..." — WH + would have + past participle + if + past perfect.

grammar.sentence: If you _____ been there, what _____ you have said?
grammar.explanation: "If you had been" — past perfect na cláusula if. "What would you have said?" na principal.

grammar.sentence: What _____ you have done if you _____ been in my place?
grammar.explanation: "What would you have done if you had been..." — pergunta com past perfect na cláusula if.

grammar.sentence: _____ she have called you if she _____ known your number?
grammar.explanation: "Would she have called you if she had known?" — third conditional pergunta yes/no.

grammar.sentence: How _____ you have reacted if it _____ happened to you?
grammar.explanation: "How would you have reacted if it had happened?" — pergunta com "how" + past perfect.

grammar.sentence: What you would have done if you had known?
grammar.hint: Inversão em pergunta — "would" antes do sujeito
grammar.answer: What would you have done if you had known?
grammar.explanation: Em pergunta, "would" vem antes do sujeito ("would you"), não depois ("you would"). Inversão obrigatória em WH-questions.

grammar.sentence: Would you helped if I had asked?
grammar.answer: Would you have helped if I had asked?
grammar.explanation: Sempre "would HAVE + past participle". "Would you helped" não existe.

grammar.passage: What would you have done if you had been in my position? Where would you have gone if you had had unlimited time? Would you have helped me if I had asked?
grammar.question: What hypothetical question is asked about position?
grammar.answer: what would you have done (or "what would you have done if you had been in my position")
grammar.explanation: The text asks "What would you have done if you had been in my position?".

listening_speaking.text: What would you have done in my place?
Would you have helped if I had asked?
Where would you have gone if you'd had time?
How would you have reacted?

units.title: Mixed conditional
units.real_life_context: You connect a past action to its present consequence — "if I had done X, I would be Y now".

grammar.sentence: If I _____ studied medicine, I _____ a doctor now.
grammar.explanation: Mixed conditional: past condition (if + past perfect) + present result (would + base). "If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now" — passado afetando presente.

grammar.sentence: She would be richer now if she _____ saved more.
grammar.explanation: Cláusula if = past perfect ("had saved"). Cláusula principal = would + base ("would be") — present result.

grammar.sentence: If we _____ moved to the city, life _____ different now.
grammar.explanation: Past condition + present result. "Had moved" + "would be" — clássico misto.

grammar.sentence: He _____ tired today if he _____ slept more last night.
grammar.explanation: "He wouldn't be tired today" (present result) + "if he had slept" (past condition).

grammar.sentence: If I _____ accepted the job, I _____ working there now.
grammar.explanation: Past action + present continuous result. "Had accepted... would be working now".

grammar.sentence: She _____ happier now if she _____ left him.
grammar.explanation: Present happiness depends on past action of leaving. Mixed conditional natural.

grammar.sentence: If they _____ invested earlier, they _____ rich now.
grammar.explanation: "Had invested" (past perfect, condition) + "would be rich now" (present result).

grammar.sentence: If I had studied medicine, I would have been a doctor now.
grammar.hint: Present result usa "would be", não "would have been"
grammar.answer: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
grammar.explanation: "Would have been" é puro terceiro condicional (passado). Para resultado PRESENTE, use "would be" — esse é o misto.

grammar.sentence: She would be richer now if she would have saved more.
grammar.answer: She would be richer now if she had saved more.
grammar.explanation: Cláusula "if" usa past perfect ("had saved"), nunca "would have".

grammar.passage: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now. She would be in Tokyo today if she had accepted the offer last year. We wouldn't be so stressed now if we had hired more people in January.
grammar.question: What would the speaker be now if they had studied medicine?
grammar.explanation: The text says "If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now".

listening_speaking.text: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
She would be richer if she had saved more.
We wouldn't be stressed if we had hired earlier.
He'd be more confident if he'd gone to therapy.
If they had moved, life would be different now.

units.title: All conditionals together

grammar.sentence: If I would have known, I would have helped.

cross_unit_consolidation: Third conditional: If + past perfect, would have + past participle (hipóteses passado)
What would you have done if + past perfect? (pergunta hipotética passada)
Mixed conditional: If + past perfect, would + base now (passado afetando presente)
Nunca "would have" dentro de cláusulas if
Distinção clara: second (presente) vs third (passado) vs misto (passado→presente)
